name: NTU VIRAL
summary: 无人机视觉、惯性、LiDAR 和 UWB 测距序列，配有地面跟踪位置真值。
summaryEn: Aerial visual, inertial, LiDAR, and UWB ranging sequences paired with ground-tracked position truth.
scale: Two LiDARs, two cameras, multiple IMUs and four onboard UWB nodes
scaleZh: 双 LiDAR、双相机、多 IMU 及四个机载 UWB 节点
access: Official repository downloads and CSV ground truth
accessZh: 官方数据下载及 CSV 真值
verdict: 多传感器飞行状态序列
wmNote: 可进行观测融合与位置演化预测；评测须处理 IMU 到真值棱镜的 0.4 米偏移。
wmNoteEn: Supports fused observations and position evolution; evaluation must account for the 0.4 m IMU-to-prism offset.

evidence.sourceTitle: NTU VIRAL DATASET · A Comprehensive Datasuite for Autonomous Aerial Vehicles
evidence.statement: Official release supplies flight sequences with synchronized cameras, lidar, IMU/UWB and ground truth.
